hypothesis: A tokenless novelty detector using only witnessed public action-outcome observations can identify inadequate primitive vocabularies and induce a reusable bounded three-input Boolean relation; a validation-gated extension should improve unseen novel-primitive predictions over fixed-grammar, same-capacity always-expanded and fully trained conventional controls, without degrading familiar or unrelated out-of-grammar functions.
interpretation: Novel here means absent from the prior three-XOR/AND/OR-gate four-distinct-variable grammar. Every invented truth-table is still a bounded 3-input Boolean function drawn from a fully specified 256-function hypothesis space. 32-state cold generalization is not evidence of inventing unconstrained relational concepts or cross-world retained knowledge.

world.public_action: set exactly one x-bit using genuine source do, 16 nonoverlapping source pairs
world.novel_definition: A hidden 3-input truth table with bit index 4*a+2*b+c, composed XOR a fourth distinct input bit; raw truth-table bits never shown to model.
world.sampling: For each fixture/phase/world, sort 64 distinct x by SHA256('AAI12T|fixture|phase|world-index|x'), ascending digest then x. Greedily choose first 16 pairs x,x XOR (1<<bit) with bit loop 0..5, neither member seen. Each chosen edge is a real one-bit source intervention. 32 unique public x/y observations; remaining 32 inputs held out and never used for inference/selection.
world.partition: The first 12 pairs (24 observations) are model-selection/fitting subset; last 4 pairs (8 observations) are validation for candidate/adaptive controls; after selecting a mode refit all 32 rows. Other full-fit controls receive the same 32 rows.
world.first_use: all worlds are publicly named mechanical source-only worlds; independent scientific first-use cohorts/seeds and any native tasks disarmed

models.fixed_grammar: Enumerate all distinct 4-variable, 3-stage XOR/AND/OR compositions with output optional invert, collapse duplicate truth tables, choose minimum 32-sample error, ties by short lexicographic description. Never enumerate the true world specification directly.
models.augmented: Enumerate sorted triples of three public input indices and fourth distinct input index. Infer a separate 8-bit ternary truth table from seen y XOR public fourth bit by majority per ternary input cell, tie value 0; choose minimum full public classification error, ties by table popcount then lexicographic (triple,fourth,mask). No hidden target tables or lookahead.
models.candidate: On first 24 public observations fit fixed/augmented/5NN; validate predictions on last 8. Select augmented only if it makes >=2 fewer validation errors than both fixed and 5NN. Else select lower-error fixed or 5NN (ties fixed). Refit selected approach on all 32 publicly seen rows. Serialize chosen mode, learnt ternary 8-bit mask and 32 public rows, restore cleanly; no per-world hidden identity. Choice is made before exposure to any heldout results.
models.no_growth_ablation: Same 24/8 selector between only fixed and 5NN, refit chosen mode on all 32; never permits ternary induction.
models.capacity: At most 32 public x/y events per method; candidate and always ternary have exactly identical 256 possible 3-input Boolean primitives and 60 bindings. ID3 fully fitted to all 32, deterministic; knn5 five nearest Hamming, stable lexical tie.
models.no_privilege: Models cannot call world generator/oracle, inspect hidden source tables, use test labels, requery unseen source x, or adapt after the frozen 32 observations.

metrics: accuracy on 768 unseen novel-primitive contexts per arm
accuracy on 256 familiar contexts per arm
accuracy on 256 six-input negative contexts per arm
novelty-trigger frequency per 12 novel and 4 familiar worlds
whole-process source catalog build/fit/selection/predict time per arm

go_no_go.invalid_if: source novelty outside original grammar not proved, any training/test overlap, unequal public information or undisclosed hidden metadata, mismatched original protocol/sha, source-runtime exception
go_no_go.stop: One prespecified source-only fixture screen. Any gate fails => DEV_NO_GO_NO_SCIENCE. No after-outcome world substitution, threshold/policy tuning, running other seeds, cost-criterion relaxation or primary science.
